name: [Event] Expansive Noob: Tower Defense
desc:
The original NTD by LohtyHD returns! With a much more refreshed look.
-This game recontinues NTD-

In this war everyone needs a hand of others.
This game uses pathfinding instead of the boring waypoints for YOUR team and the ENEMY team, some units may not walk and be static for a simple strategy.

This job is not suited for everyone, or not for the Weaks. - Swordmaster
All the instructions for this job can be found on the information button! Remember this is not an actual job (this is just written for lore purposes).

I'm trying to expand the TD genre to other ways than just placing units and defending.

EN:TD Isn't your average tower defense and takes strategy more seriously.
EN:TD Is mainly inspired by PvZ, Ultrakill and Tower Galactica. 
EN:TD Group/Community: https://www.roblox.com/communities/3438842/Water-Studio-s#!/about

If the game kicks you is because it might be updating or is private.
(This game is still in development, and many things are subject to change)
